lockup.summary: The company, its directors and officers, and nearly all other holders agreed not to sell shares for 180 days after the prospectus date without the underwriters' consent. After that, the remaining shares can be sold.

what: Iambic uses artificial intelligence and automated lab work to discover and develop new medicines, with drug candidates in clinical trials.
risks: Iambic is young and has no approved products, so it is hard to judge its prospects.
It has lost a lot of money since it started and may never become profitable.
It will need a large amount of extra money to develop its drug candidates and run its business.
Its quarterly and yearly results may swing widely, which could push its stock price down.
Future deals or acquisitions could raise its costs, dilute shareholders, add debt, or bring other risks.
risks_note: The first 5 risk factors, summarised by AI.
